arguments.old_string:
**Purpose:** Bridges an opencode rate-limit window with freebuff: announces when opencode resumes (clock time), ensures freebuff is ready (MiniMax M3, standard mode) and hands the terminal to its interactive session, then sleeps whatever remains of the window after freebuff exits and returns so the loop switches back to opencode (the faster of the two).

**Parameters:**
- `wait_seconds: int` — the rate-limit wait from run_opencode (header retry-after or the 20 h default). Positive.

**Returns:** `None`, only after the full window has elapsed.

**Side effects:** Prints handoff status (flushed); everything `ensure_freebuff` does; runs the blocking interactive freebuff session inheriting the terminal; sleeps the remaining window.

**Raises:** Nothing beyond what `ensure_freebuff` raises.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `plan_tasks` and `ralph_loop` when run_opencode reports a rate limit. Calls `ensure_freebuff`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-09 — initial implementation, sequence verified with stubbed subprocess/sleep (freebuff session, then sleep of remaining window).
arguments.new_string:
**Purpose:** Bridges an opencode rate-limit window with freebuff: announces when opencode resumes (clock time), ensures freebuff is ready (MiniMax M3, standard mode), then — when tmux is available and ralph/tasks.md exists — drives freebuff autonomously through tasks via `run_freebuff_until` for the duration of the window; without tmux it hands the terminal to the interactive freebuff session instead. Afterwards sleeps whatever remains of the window (skipped when all tasks are already done) and returns so the loop switches back to opencode (the faster of the two).

**Parameters:**
- `goal: str` — the user's overall goal, passed through to freebuff task prompts. Non-empty.
- `wait_seconds: int` — the rate-limit wait from run_opencode (header retry-after or the 20 h default). Positive.

**Returns:** `None`, only after the full window has elapsed (or all tasks completed).

**Side effects:** Prints handoff status (flushed); everything `ensure_freebuff` and `run_freebuff_until` do; may run the blocking interactive freebuff session; sleeps the remaining window.

**Raises:** Nothing beyond what `ensure_freebuff` raises.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `plan_tasks`, `ralph_loop`, and `verify_task` when run_opencode reports a rate limit. Calls `ensure_freebuff`, `run_freebuff_until`, `count_incomplete_tasks`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-09 — freebuff leg is now tmux-driven and autonomous; interactive handoff kept only as the no-tmux fallback.
